mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a supply crunch that will drive up costs and compress corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% y/y, it signals a boom in residential investment that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100k jobs per month y/y, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS y/y growth < -100k jobs/mo.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth slows by more than 2% q/q, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS q/q growth < -2% and UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in CPI inflation above 3% y/y, combined with a flat or inverted yield curve, signals a stagflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3% y/y and FEDFUNDS is inverted.
